description: This file defines the LocationDao class, which provides data access methods for Location entities in the Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for fetching, searching, counting, saving, and deleting location records, as well as retrieving associated data like employee counts and location IDs based on various filters.

classes.name: LocationDao
classes.description: Data access object class for Location entities, providing methods to retrieve, search, save, and delete location data.

methods.name: getLocationById
methods.description: Fetches a Location entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getExistingLocationIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing location IDs from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Location records matching specific search filters.

methods.name: searchLocations
methods.description: Searches for Location entities based on search filters and returns matching objects.

methods.name: searchLocationsPaginator
methods.description: Prepares and returns a Paginator object for location search results based on filters.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Returns the number of employees associated with a specific location.

methods.name: getLocationsIdList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all location IDs, ordered by name.

methods.name: getLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Returns location IDs associated with specified employee numbers.

methods.name: getLocationsByIds
methods.description: Retrieves Location entities corresponding to given IDs.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Persists a Location object to the database.

methods.name: deleteLocations
methods.description: Deletes Location records with specified IDs and returns the count of deleted records.
